name: Swisher x 5-Pack .5g Infused Blunts | Blueberry Pie
description: Enjoy the perfect fusion of sweet vanilla and tart blueberry with Swisher Blunts Blueberry Pie. Swisher 5-Pack Infused Blunts feature five 0.5-gram blunts crafted with quality flower and enhanced with cannabis concentrate for added potency and flavor. Designed for a slow, even burn, they deliver smooth smoke with bold, consistent effects. A convenient option for consumers looking for a flavorful, high-potency blunt experience.
